Chapter 6943: Destruction

Chapter 6943: Destruction

The crowd cared little for Breaker and his branch due to their notorious methods. Today, they were more than willing to see this mortal take down Breaker.

After all, they weren’t the mortal’s targets and had nothing to lose.

“Hahaha, no one has made this claim for epochs now...” Treasure’s anger manifested into boisterous laughter.

“Only takes one.” Li Qiye waved dismissively.

“Very well, only one of us will leave this place alive today.” Treasure gritted his teeth.

“You are not enough, summon your father and uncles.” Li Qiye said.

“It’s going to be a fun show today.” An immortal whispered. The bigger the show, the better it would be for them.

“So be it, you’re not leaving this place after starting this.” Treasure took out a whistle and blew it.

“Wssh!” The sound echoed across space.

“Rumble!” Radiant immortals appeared everywhere in the various firmaments of Ancient.

One was massive and looked as big as the firmament below him. Another traveled through the river of time. The third slashed his sword brilliantly to arrive in the present...

Not only were the immortals of Breacker summoned, but slumbering immortals in Heavenrealm also woke up after sensing the disturbance.

“Why is there a summoning call?” Apex and Heaven’s Equal branches felt alarmed.

This branch always caused devastating casualties with each mobilization. Of course, the other two branches had a pact of neutrality.

“The nine immortals of Breaker.” One spectator said.

Putting Breaker Immortal aside, the branch had nine more immortals - two golden and seven grand ones.

However, Perpetual had been turned into a candle while another was crucified by invisible laws. As for overlords, the branch had several dozen.

“Rumble!” One immortal’s appearance crushed the firmament and all living beings.

“Breaker Immortal!” Everyone felt his primordial aura.

He was sleeping in a firmament and nourished it with his presence. This made it possible for many emperors and ancient ancestors to appear. In fact, a few overlords also emerged.

Unfortunately, destruction came next. Breaker wasn’t happy to be awakened early and had no attachment to this firmament.

If he didn’t actively restrain his power upon awakening, nothing would be left. This was proven with the firmament’s destruction. Perhaps only a few were lucky enough to survive.

His muscular figure stood on the river of time. An activated state could shake all of Heavenrealm. If it wasn’t for his primordial aura, one could mistake him for an ape.

People couldn’t help stealing glances at Treasure Immortal Lord. The son did look like a golden immortal or a spoiled young master. His father, on the other hand, was barbaric and wild.
